verse.text: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

about: I'm Jossaya, a second-year computer engineering student at UF. For the last few years, I have been exploring my passion for applied machine learning and computer vision through research experience, coursework, and personal projects.
I'm also drawn to software engineering, full-stack web development, and embedded systems.
